title: Detecting and Preventing Misuse of SkillsFuture Credits
what_it_is: Detecting and Preventing Misuse of SkillsFuture Credits

sections.label: SSG enforcement and third-party marketing ban
sections.summary: SSG takes enforcement actions against training providers who flout guidelines and from 1 December 2025 will disallow them from engaging third parties to market courses directly to learners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: When SSG guidelines are flouted, SSG takes enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include suspension or termination of a training provider's registration with SSG.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SSG publishes the list of training providers who have flouted the terms and were subject to enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: From 1 December 2025, SSG will disallow registered training providers from engaging, requesting or procuring any third party to market courses directly to learners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This is necessary given an increase in public feedback on undesirable marketing practices involving third parties over the past year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This new prohibition will reduce the risk of the public being subject to misrepresentation, over-promising or undue influence when third parties are involved in the marketing of training programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: It can also avoid the compromise of personal data when third parties ask for such data to facilitate course sign-ups.

sections.label: Course ratings on MySkillsFuture Portal
sections.summary: The ratings of each course are published on the MySkillsFuture Portal to help learners make informed training decisions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The ratings of each course are published on the MySkillsFuture Portal to help learners make informed training decisions.

sections.label: Feedback and audits for course quality
sections.summary: Feedback is sought to take remedial action so courses are fit for purpose, and audits assess quality and verify that stated training is delivered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But indeed we want to get the feedback so that we can take remedial action to make sure that the course, the subject, the approach and the assessment techniques, for example, are fit for purpose and serve learners as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And indeed, we do conduct audits so that we have various methods of assessing the quality and to verify that the training that is stated is actually being delivered.
